UTF-16 splitting closes/reopens HTML tags and intentionally trims boundary whitespace; not byte-preserving file chunking.
Degenerate limits may emit a rune larger than the limit; bounded refinement does not prove universal compliance for pathological markup.
Tag beginning at byte zero can be split; entity references have no separate boundary protection. Static observations, not executed reproductions.
Short unbalanced HTML passes through unchanged by explicit source test.
Command parser strips any bot @suffix without validating bot name; status allowlists still applied. Topic thread used only for IsTopicMessage.
Button tracker uses structured chat/message key, mutex, FIFO cap, and moves refreshed records to the back; expiry is strict now.Before(expiresAt), so exact TTL boundary is expired.
Lookup/Valid reject expired records without deleting them; Len includes expired records until sweep or consume.

Sweep removes all expired records before network edits; failed edits are not retried. Cancellation mid-batch can leave subsequent already-removed keyboards visible, although tracker authorization rejects them. Static source observation.
Tracker capacity eviction intentionally leaves visible orphan keyboards; restart also loses in-memory state. Unlike the main dedup cache, this tracker supports a size cap.
Status output distinguishes last webhook from last delivery; pipeline checks are sequential with separate timeout contexts and are not proof that every notification completed.
Missing-watchdog branch interpolates configured alert name with percent-q without HTML escaping; compactError truncates by bytes and can split UTF-8. Neither observation has been executed.
Poller advances in-memory offset before synchronous handler dispatch, recovers panics, and does not retry handler failure. Restart loses offset; this is not durable exactly-once delivery.

Updates below current offset are still dispatched: offset guards advancement only, not dispatch. Normal server ordering may avoid this; duplicate input behavior is a static observation, not reproduced.
Handler timeouts are cooperative contexts, not goroutine interruption; a handler ignoring context can still stall serial dispatch.
Polling errors use exponential 1..30 second backoff; RetryAfter parsed by GetUpdates is not consulted by the poller.
HTTP polling uses 1 MiB limited reads, ignores read errors, and rejects malformed JSON; successful HTTP ok=false loses original API error code and description.
Dedup counters include source/chat/status labels, whereas the shared reservation key lacks source. Observability label separation does not provide key isolation.
Per-chat metric label cardinality grows with distinct chats; size gauges expose cache lengths, not necessarily live unexpired records.
